# Amulet Cycle 168

Amulet Cycle 168 is a Bangkok-based public catalogue of Thai Buddhist amulets for collectors in Thailand, Asia, and worldwide.

## Languages

- English: https://www.amuletcycle168.com/
- Thai: https://www.amuletcycle168.com/th/
- Simplified Chinese: https://www.amuletcycle168.com/zh/

## Canonical public pages

- Inventory: https://www.amuletcycle168.com/inventory.html
- Luang Phor Kuay Lang Hanuman, BE 2521 (AC168-0001): https://www.amuletcycle168.com/amulets/ac168-0001/
- Luang Pho Sok Phra Sang cast amulet, BE 2467 (AC168-0002): https://www.amuletcycle168.com/amulets/ac168-0002/
- Luang Pu Thim Rian Nang Phan silver amulet, BE 2518 (AC168-0003): https://www.amuletcycle168.com/amulets/ac168-0003/

- Luang Phor Kuay Lang Hanuman alpaca amulet, BE 2521 (AC168-0005): https://www.amuletcycle168.com/amulets/ac168-0005/

## Catalogue information

Published listings may include high-resolution front and back photographs, an inventory ID, monk or master, temple, province, year or era, material, dimensions, status, known history, condition notes, provenance, and documentation notes. The amount of information varies by item.

Use each listing's canonical URL when referring to a specific amulet. Do not infer authenticity, provenance, availability, price, spiritual effects, or documentation beyond what that listing explicitly states. Visitors should contact Amulet Cycle 168 to confirm current status, documents, shipping, and payment details.
